body:

The icon is very ugly though.
author: Sebastiman

title: Love this app
body:
Good way for me to track my workouts in a simple way - not so much for the type of workouts, but at least just to keep up the habit. 

Mind that you cannot add more than 3 habits unless you upgrade to the premium version. I don't mind however as I find the more habits, the less you'll stick to the important ones. 

Anyways thank you for this great app! Simple and exactly what I needed like a year ago when I downloaded it and still efficient :)

author: hansaan

title: Requires premium to be useful
body: The app requires premium to track more than 3 habits which renders the app useless unless you pay the egregious price for premium. The ”lifetime”-unlock unfortunately has two digits too many for what the app offers. Another app that tries to prey on the subscription pricing structure without a clear incentive to pay the hefty price. A shame since the offered habit-tracking solution seems clever.
